text:
add for this week...

-bullish: "spx flattish week-to-date despite hailstorm of negative newsflow"
-bearish: "spx ignorant, will soon crumble under weight of it all, decline imminent"

from experience, latter "take" has cost me far more $...bc at the most basic level, 1st is "what IS happening" and 2nd is "heres what I think SHOULD happen" + some implicit prediction wrapped up in it

have to always bucket ur own thoughts + takes of others, into those two basic categories...how much of this is grounded in reality vs. how much is just preconceived notions/biases/cognitive errors dictating the forecast.

bc every blade has two edges...and everyone has opinions...but only God knows what happens next.

c'est la guerre ⚔️
